text:
Natalie: FYI team — Marta has submitted her resignation, last day is 2024-07-15 (EMEA). Need to coordinate benefits wrap, equipment return, access removal, and exit interview. @Leo please confirm knowledge transfer plan. :wave:

Leo: Thanks Natalie. Confirmed. Marta will do two 1-hr handoffs next week (Mon/Tue). I'll capture docs in the ENG handbook and tag owners.

Marta: Happy to do the sessions. I can be remote for the handoffs. My coworking space has a dropbox for returns or I can ship the laptop.

Ben (IT): OK. Which laptop model/serial? We also need the company charger and YubiKey if issued. If shipping, we'll email a prepaid label.

Marta: MacBook Pro 16" (S/N C02X1234H8WN), company USB-C charger, YubiKey v2. I left the coworking desk booking info in the dropbox note.

Natalie: Great — Ben please schedule courier pickup for 2024-07-16. Also: schedule Okta deprovision and VPN access removal for 2024-07-15 18:00 UTC (end of day). Olivia can confirm security window.

Olivia (Security): Lockdown window confirmed. We'll run deprovision at 18:00 UTC on 2024-07-15. Ben please include network token revocation and MDM wipe in the runbook.

Ben (IT): Adding to the runbook. Deprovision steps (for audit):
```
# deprovision user
deprovision --user marta.silva --revoke-vpn --revoke-keys --mdm-wipe --export-ssh-keys
```
I'll attach the runbook link after I add the laptop S/N.

Aisha (Payroll): Heads up on final pay: need Marta to submit any outstanding expenses and fill the final bi-weekly timesheet by 2024-07-10. We'll calculate pro-rata PTO and last paycheck including statutory benefits. Marta: please confirm your preferred banking details for the final transfer (last last four digits ok).

Marta: I'll submit timesheet + expenses by EOD 2024-07-10. Bank last 4 digits are 4321.

BenefitsBot: For EMEA employees we don't run COBRA. Enrollment continuation options vary by country: UK (occupational health/pension opt-out forms), DE (Bescheinigung), IE/ES local forms. People Ops will send country-specific docs. Deadline to accept any continuation is 30 days post-termination in some regions.

Natalie: I'll send Marta the country packet (pension transfer instructions, health continuation choices, and any tax docs like P45 equivalent). Marta, expect an email with links + opt-in deadlines by tomorrow.

Marta: Thanks — please also include info on pension transfer (I want to move to my new provider).

Natalie: Noted. I'll loop in our benefits broker to process pension port (they usually take ~4-6 weeks).

Olivia (Security): One more: please rotate any service account credentials Marta had direct access to. @Leo list any internal service keys she used in the handoff doc.

Leo: Will do. I'll add a list of repos, deploy keys, and monitoring runbooks to the handoff doc before the sessions.

Ben (IT): Runbook and courier label created. I'll post links here once live.

Natalie: Exit interview scheduling — Marta, do you prefer a 30-min Zoom with People Ops or a written form?

Marta: 30-min Zoom is fine. Morning CET preferred.

Natalie: Scheduled for 2024-07-12 09:30 CET (Zoom link will be DM). Closing checklist for everyone:
- Marta: timesheet/expenses, ship/dropoff kit
- Ben: courier label, MDM & deprovision at EOD last day
- Olivia: rotate creds + final access audit
- Aisha: payroll final calc + confirm bank details
- Leo: document handoffs + list of service keys
- Benefits/People Ops: send country packets & pension transfer initiation

Natalie: Thanks all. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
